handback.title: Setup saves safely; agents and test setup follow settings
handback.summary: Setup saves settings without losing anything, agents come from the settings file, and test workflows set up as it says.
handback.user_story: Setup keeps a settings file intact, agents come from it, and test workflows install what it names.

acceptance_criteria.text: A settings file holding lists is read in full, on every machine that runs Dokima.
acceptance_criteria.words: A settings file holding lists is read in full, on every machine that runs Dokima.
